echoParts: And in the days of those kings
verseText: And in the days of those kings the God of heaven will set up a kingdom that shall never be destroyed.
meaning: Earthly kingdoms do not last forever. But Jesus' kingdom will last forever, and no one will ever be able to destroy it.
